# Logo

The SuDu AI logo.

`SuDuAI.Logo` · Brand

## Use



## Notes

The primary SuDu AI logo — the supplied alien-head + wordmark lockup. Use this wherever the brand signs a surface.

## Props (LogoProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | `number` | Rendered height in px; width follows the artwork's 205.68:50.79 ratio. Default 28. |
| `color` | `string` | Fill color. Default --on-surface. Use --primary-container on dark accent grounds, --brand-obsidian knocked out of neon. |
| `title` | `string` | Accessible label. Default "SuDu AI". |
